theme: An open day, a busy tomorrow
greeting: The calendar is clear today in St. Pete — a genuinely open day with the girls home. The pull is a cluster of overdue bookings with real deadlines, and the two Brunswick calls waiting first thing tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority Todoist task to reserve a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has sat since mid-September. Holiday inventory in that market sells out, so booking early is the whole point — a refundable hold costs nothing now.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break plan
needsAttention.detail: The December-break task (decide by Sept 30, book by Oct 15) is past both dates. Six people over the holidays means inventory only thins from here — pick domestic-or-international and shortlist three.

needsAttention.title: Prep for the two Brunswick calls
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow brings back-to-back Brunswick conversations — Jonathan Doorley at 10:00 and Christian Buss at 1:30, both on Teams. Worth arriving with your board-search narrative sharp.

flagged.title: Two new role alerts

flagged.title: Amex October statement ready
